name: Ellmauer Hof
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Ellmauer Hof in Tirol** – a historic alpine retreat nestled in the heart of the **Zillertal Alps**, just a short drive from **Innsbruck**. Since 1850, this family-run **Berghotel** has been welcoming guests with its timeless charm, breathtaking mountain views, and an atmosphere where tradition meets modern comfort.

### **A Taste of Tirol**
Indulge in authentic **Tiroler** cuisine at our **Restaurant Ellmauer Hof**, where every dish tells a story. Start your day with a hearty **Kaiserschmarrn** and **Apfelstrudel**, or savor our famous **Tiroler Gröstl**—crispy potatoes, onions, and bacon, served with a dollop of **Käsekrainer** and a fresh **Brotzeit**. For meat lovers, our **Zillertaler Kalbsbraten** (tender veal roast) or **Almkäse** (creamy alpine cheese) are must-tries. Pair your meal with a glass of local **Apfelwein** or a frothy **Tiroler Bier** from the **Zillertal Brauerei**.

### **Relax & Unwind**
After a day of hiking, skiing, or exploring the **Karwendel** or **Ötztal** regions, recharge in our **Wellness Oasis**. Soak in the **Almwiesen Therme**—a natural hot spring with panoramic views—or unwind in our **Sauna Landschaften** with **Infrarotkabine**, **Schwitzhütte**, and **Erlebnisbad**. For the little ones, our **Kinderland** offers a playful escape with slides, pools, and games.

### **Adventure Awaits**
Whether you're a **Skifahrer**, **Snowboarder**, or **Wanderer**, Ellmauer Hof is your gateway to **Tirol’s** finest outdoor experiences. In winter, glide down the slopes of **Ahornbahn** or **Gerlosberg**, just steps from our door. In summer, lace up your hiking boots and explore trails like the **Zillertal Höhenweg** or the **Karwendelpanorama**. For thrill-seekers, try **Paragliding** in **Mayrhofen** or **Mountainbiking** along the **Ziller River**.

### **Events & Traditions**
Experience the magic of **Tirol** through our seasonal festivals. In summer, join our **Almabtrieb** (cattle drive) celebrations with music, dancing, and hearty feasts. In winter, warm up by the fire with **Glühwein** and **Krapfen** during our **Christmas Market** or enjoy a cozy **Silvesterabend** with fireworks and champagne.

### **Why Choose Us?**
✔ **Central Location** – Close to **Innsbruck**, **Mayrhofen**, and **St. Anton**
✔ **Authentic Hospitality** – Warm **Tiroler** welcome since 1850
✔ **Year-Round Activities** – Skiing, hiking, wellness, and culture
✔ **Family-Friendly** – From **Wellness** for adults to **Kinderland** for kids

**Plan your escape to the Alps today**—where every stay feels like coming home. **Willkommen im Ellmauer Hof!** 🏔️✨
